**Starbucks' fiscal Q4 2026 results have not been reported yet**, so those figures aren't available.

## Status
Starbucks' fiscal Q4/FY2026 covers the quarter ended ~September 27, 2026. The company has not yet released those results. Based on its earnings calendar, the Q4 and full-year fiscal 2026 report is scheduled for **around October 28, 2026** — with some sources pointing to ~Oct 27–29 ([MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-10-28-starbucks-co-stock), [TIKR](https://www.tikr.com/blog/starbucks-is-weighing-a-japan-stake-sale-heres-what-it-means-for-the-turnaround), [Kalkine](https://kalkine.com/news/consumer/what-comes-next-for-starbucks-nasdaqsbux-after-niccol-declares-the-turnaround-complete)). As of now, no company press release exists for Q4 FY2026 — Starbucks' investor site only lists results through Q3 FY2026.

## Most recent reported quarter (Q3 FY2026, ended June 28, 2026)
For context, here's what Starbucks most recently reported:

| Metric | Q3 FY2026 |
|---|---|
| Global comparable store sales | **+7.9%** (4th straight quarter of growth; transactions +4.2%, ticket +3.5%) |
| North America comps | +8.1% (U.S. +7.9%) |
| International comps | +5.7% |
| Consolidated net revenues | **$9.3 billion** (down ~1% YoY due to the China joint-venture transition) |
| Adjusted EPS | $0.85 (vs. $0.66 expected) |

Sources: [Starbucks Q3 FY2026 press release](https://about.starbucks.com/press/2026/starbucks-reports-q3-fiscal-year-2026-results), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/starbucks-sbux-q3-2026-earnings.html), [Investor Relations](https://investor.starbucks.com/news/financial-releases/news-details/2026/Starbucks-Reports-Q3-Fiscal-Year-2026-Results/default.aspx)

## FY2026 guidance (updated with Q3)
- Global comparable store sales growth: ~6%
- U.S. comps: "a little more than" 6%
- Non-GAAP EPS: $2.55–$2.65

I'd recommend re-checking after the late-October release for the actual Q4 FY2026 global comps and net revenue figures.
